g.title: Workflow
g.text: CI classification, quota exceptions and agent recovery

a.xlink:title: Pending check
a.text: Wait for observable result; do not assume

a.xlink:title: Quota-limited or unavailable
a.text: Identify repo policy and check criticality

a.xlink:title: Record documented exception
a.text: No claim of CI pass; manual evidence

a.xlink:title: Block or request alternate proof
a.text: Rerun, local tests or human decision

a.xlink:title: Re-review current head
a.text: Diff, CI state, issues and readiness

a.xlink:title: Focused corrective chunk
a.text: Only if session healthy and converging

a.xlink:title: CI event
a.text: Push, PR, dispatch or scheduled run

a.xlink:title: Continue on new branch
a.text: Use old Jules work as read-only context
